name: Delete Opportunities
summary: Permanently deletes opportunity records, matched by their CRM ID (default) or Marketo GUID. Up to 300 per call.
whenToUse: When opportunity records in Marketo should be removed. There is no undo.
confirm: This PERMANENTLY deletes up to 300 opportunity records. This cannot be undone. Continue?

body.hint: Comma-separated IDs to delete — by default the external (CRM) opportunity IDs.

fields.name: deleteBy
fields.label: Delete by
fields.hint: If you switch to marketoGUID, paste GUIDs in the values box instead.

response.description: Per record: marketoGUID and status (deleted or skipped with a reason).
